contention_finding.observed: twice, a cash chained on the bank's unconfirmed output passed /transactions/check and POST, sat in the mempool for <0.2 s (14.r: polls 200 then 404) and was never mined; resubmitted on the confirmed bank box it was mined (14.r2). Node log (14.r): candidate assembly for block 275 began 'from 3 transactions available' (emission, 13.r, 14.r) and regenerated 0.15 s later 'from 2'.
contention_finding.control: ../probe-chain.json: two chained spends of a trivial keyless script (HEIGHT > 0, no token) stayed in the mempool 3 s and were mined in one block (279)
contention_finding.cause: [UNVERIFIED] specific to the bank's transaction (it carries an NFT and AVL proofs; the control carries neither); not isolated
